seo.title: Café Hafa Tangier | Strait Views & Mint Tea Terraces | MoroccoTripMap
seo.description: Café Hafa sits on the cliffs of Tangier with terraced views over the Strait of Gibraltar — a classic stop for mint tea and sunset light.
seo.keywords: Café Hafa, Cafe Hafa Tangier, Tangier viewpoint café

name: Café Hafa
hero_subtitle: Cliff terraces and mint tea above the strait.

overview.title: Tangier’s most famous tea view
overview.p1: Café Hafa has stacked terraces facing the Strait of Gibraltar. Writers and locals have used it for decades as a simple place to sit with mint tea and watch ships between Morocco and Spain.
overview.p2: It is about the view and the pause, not fine dining. Come for light and atmosphere; order tea or a soft drink and expect a shared, informal terrace culture.

s2.caption: View toward the Strait of Gibraltar

1.title: Quiet tables
1.desc: Fewer visitors and softer strait light.

2.title: Classic pause
2.desc: Tea and long views — the ritual most people come for.

3.title: Golden cliff
3.desc: The most sought-after seats as the light drops over the water.

food.title: What to order
food.p1: Keep it simple: mint tea is the ritual. Soft drinks and basic items may be available; this is not a full restaurant.
food.li1: Mint tea is the classic order.
food.li4: Pair with a medina meal before or after.

1.title: Getting there
1.desc: Walk from the kasbah area or take a petit taxi to Marshan / Café Hafa.

2.title: Seats
2.desc: Terraces are stepped; arrive early for sunset.

3.title: Wind
3.desc: Cliff-top breeze can be cool — a light layer helps.

q1.question: Do I have to order?
q1.answer: Yes — it is a working café. Tea is the usual minimum.

q2.question: Is food served?
q2.answer: Focus is drinks and the view; do not expect a full menu.

q3.question: Best time to come?
q3.answer: Late afternoon through sunset for the classic atmosphere.

q4.question: How far from the medina?
q4.answer: A walk from the kasbah edge or a short taxi ride.

q5.question: Is it touristy?
q5.answer: Popular with visitors and locals; the view still earns the stop.
